name: MCP Startup Framework
description: A comprehensive framework for building remote MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers featuring OAuth 2.1 authentication, PostgreSQL integration, and Stripe-powered paid tools. It enables developers to create scalable, platform-agnostic MCP tools with support for user registration and subscription-based functionality.
